hooks.name: Run checks before finishing
hooks.description: Runs pnpm check when the agent stops. Sends it back with the list while anything fails, at most 3 times in a row, then tells it to ask the user.

hooks.name: Reset check attempts on a new message
hooks.description: Each new user message gives the agent a fresh set of attempts.

hooks.name: Protect enforcement files and planned code
hooks.description: Blocks agent writes to protected files, to existing guarded files the committed change plan does not list, and outside a worktree task's file list.

hooks.name: Protect enforcement files and planned code (shell)
hooks.description: The same protection for shell commands that write files. Pattern-based: a guard against accidents, not a security boundary.
